# Rules every agent follows

## Cost

- A paid image or video tool is capped at 30 credits per task. Above that, stop and
  report instead of continuing.
- Do not re-read a file that `/prime` already loaded.
- Research writes into a run folder. It does not append to a curated file.

## Honesty

- A figure without a source does not get written down.
- A source that could not be opened is reported as unreachable, not quietly dropped and
  not replaced by a different source that happens to say something similar.
- Where a transcript or an export is garbled, verify at the primary source and write the
  corrected value, with the address where it was verified.

## Hand-off

- Finished work goes to `inbox/` with a one-line summary of what it is and what decision
  it needs.
- Nothing is published, sent or scheduled without a person saying so.
